source_semantics.selection: The canonical service returns only External execution jobs whose status is Waiting and whose owner and site identities are present.
source_semantics.ordering: Eligible jobs are returned oldest first by creation time.
source_semantics.limit: The requested take is clamped to the inclusive range 1..100, with a default of 20.
source_semantics.side_effects: The operation is a read-only queue enumeration and never starts, executes, progresses, completes, fails, or retries external work.

laravel_adaptation.ledger_mapping: Canonical External jobs reuse the existing tenant-owned operation_executions control plane; payload.execution_mode preserves External and queued preserves source Waiting state.
laravel_adaptation.tenant_scope: Active TenantContext is mandatory and operations.manage is authorized server-side before reading. The query is always constrained to active tenant_id and cannot enumerate another tenant's queue.
laravel_adaptation.identity_scope: Only rows with a non-null requested_by_user_id and a positive site subject identity are eligible, preserving the source OwnerUserId/SiteId presence requirement.
laravel_adaptation.ordering_and_limit: Rows are scanned oldest-first by created_at with deterministic id tie-break; only External rows are admitted and enumeration stops at the source-compatible clamp of 1..100.
laravel_adaptation.redaction: Projected title, type, site name, idempotency display and failure text redact credential-shaped values; dedupe fingerprints and raw payload are never exposed.
laravel_adaptation.external_runtime_boundary: This adapter only reads control-plane metadata and does not call WordPress, providers, email, payment, DNS, queues, or any live production runtime.
